The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 7% (2021: 10%) component of the 2022 loss ratio of 47% (2021: 46%). The earned loss ratio represents net incurred losses divided by net earned premium.
data.standardized_narrative: The gross prior-year reserve movement calculated from the syndicate's gross claims development tables shows a small net release of GBP 6.1m (c. -0.65% of opening gross claims outstanding). This net release masks mixed experience by line: favourable development in property and marine-related lines outweighed adverse development in third party liability. The report attributes the overall movement primarily to favourable loss experience; the per-class movements shown elsewhere in the notes are presented net of reinsurance and therefore differ from the gross triangle-derived figure.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was derived from the gross claims development tables (triangle). The report also presents a per-class prior year movement table (total favourable movement 44.7m) which is presented net of reinsurance and therefore does not match the gross triangle-derived PYD. The triangle contains a '2017 & Prior' aggregate column which has been excluded per instructions; the triangle-based PYD therefore excludes that aggregated column. Line-of-business mappings are approximate for combined statutory classes (e.g. 'Marine, aviation and transport' mapped to 'Marine'; 'Miscellaneous' mapped to 'Aggregate') and per-class movements taken from the note are net of reinsurance (lower confidence).
